_doc: Fighter lifecycle constants: development, aging, retirement, injuries, captaincy, chemistry, statuses, generation. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. Units follow docs/design/03 section 1: stats are integers on the absolute 1-20 scale, rating and potential are integers 1-100, probabilities are basis points in code. Fractions and multipliers are decimals in this file; the loader converts every fractional value to integer basis points (x10000, round half away from zero) and lifecycle math runs on integers. Base stats are stored internally as hundredths of a point ('centipoints', 100-2000). Tables given as [key, value] pairs are step tables (use the entry with the largest key <= the lookup value) unless the block says interpolate.
status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). Owner-mandated parts cite O-IDs in the spec; everything else is PROPOSED and every number is TUNABLE.

scale._capsNote: TUNABLE (combat cmb-q11): race tendencies |x| <= 4 per stat, trait stat adds |x| <= 3 per stat; fragility/durability is expressed mainly through injury chance and recovery multipliers. Validator-enforced.
scale._doc: Display stat = floor(effective centipoints / 100), clamp 1..20; this integer is what combat receives (fight setup). Effective centipoints = base centipoints + 100 * (sum of whole-point trait, status and chemistry modifiers). Rating = clamp(round(5 * sum(w_i * stat_i)), 1, 100) on these integer stats (D-Q: one formula everywhere), with w_i = classes.json ratingWeights of the fighter's class. Potential = the same formula with every base stat at its cap, no wear, and only permanent modifiers (physique and scar traits); it therefore drops when a scar is gained (P-12 'injury' change).

time._doc: humanAge = age * 80 / race.lifespan, kept in tenths (floor(age * 800 / lifespan) / 10). Season rate scale k = 80 / race.lifespan. Development and decline of a season use the age the fighter had during that season; the +1 increment follows (season-end step 5).

potential._doc: Potential P (1-100) is rolled once at generation and is mostly fixed (P-12). Bands are generation weights only; the star display is potential / 20 in half-star steps (docs/design/03 section 1).
potential.capFromPotential: cap100_i = clamp(round(P * 20 + classOffset100_i + 100 * race.statTendencies[tag_i] + jitter100_i), capMin*100, capMax*100)

classOffsetFromEmphasis._doc: classOffset_i (points) = clamp(perEmphasisPoint * (class.statEmphasis_i - 1), min, max), then recentred so that sum(ratingWeights_i * classOffset_i) = 0. Uses classes.json statEmphasis; if a class has none, fall back to fallbackByRatingWeightRank.

qualityShiftExamples._label: EXAMPLE. The league/economy designer owns tier quality bands (docs/design/03 section 1) and sets these.

pace._doc: Hidden development pace (true value shown in M1; fog hook for M4). Multiplies the development clock.

developmentClock._doc: Two clocks per fighter, D_physical and D_mental, in human-years of development (stored in hundredths). Per season: dD_g = k * pace * usage * race.growthMult[g] * emphasisMult[g] * traitDevMult[g] * mentorMult(if humanAge <= 23), capped at maxDeltaPerSeason. usage = usageFloor + (1 - usageFloor) * min(1, seasonXp / xp.seasonTarget).

maturityCurve._doc: developed100_i = cap100_i * M_g(D_g + bloom_i). Interpolate linearly; clamp below the first and above the last point.

decline._doc: Wear in stat points per human-year (step table on floor(humanAge during the season) - traitDeclineShift). Per season: wear100_i += 100 * d_g * k * race.declineMult[g] * traitDeclineMult * emphasisWearMult. base100_i = max(100, developed100_i - wear100_i). Wear never heals.
decline._mentalDeclineNote: DELEGATED (D-B; open-025 pending owner confirmation): true. true: mental decline starts at humanAge 60 for every race (elf 90, dwarf 54, orc 48, ashkin 39), i.e. never during a playing career. false: it starts at absolute age 60 for every race (elf humanAge 40, the last seasons of an elf career).

xp._doc: XP is earned only for rounds a fighter starts (O3: a called-up fighter who is not used gains no XP). Bench, injured, unused called-up academy fighters and free agents earn 0.
xp._seasonTargetNote: TUNABLE: about 70% of the XP a full-time starter earns over 16 best-of-3 league matches (16 * ~2.5 rounds * ~12.8 XP). Recompute if the match format changes.

training._doc: DELEGATED (D-A, docs/design/03 sys-development): a standing training emphasis per fighter (set once, persists; not a weekly chore). It shapes WHICH stats the earned growth goes to, never how much: with emphasisBonus = offEmphasisPenalty the physical and mental multipliers always sum to 2, and bodyWearReduction is 0 (no wear effect). fBody and fMind are the season's shares of the 23 weeks under each emphasis. Setting enabled=false makes everyone Balanced, which reproduces no-training behaviour exactly. Emphasis is not intensity and has no injury risk.

formulas.a: product of trainingEmphasis effect mults (human Adaptable 1.5, Regimented 1.5, Set in Their Ways 0); clamp a to [0, 2]

trend._doc: Live development trend = projected rating change at season end if the fighter's XP per matchweek so far continues (projected seasonXp = seasonXp * 19 / weeksElapsed).
trend._rounding: projected delta is an integer rating difference; pick the first level whose minDelta <= delta

retirement._doc: D-T: p = 1 - (1 - hDrop)(1 - hAge)^k with hDrop at careerPeakRating - rating, hAge at human-age - physicalPeakHumanAge, k = 80 / lifespan; then the modifiers; 0 below minHumanAge, 1 from forcedHumanAge. Rolled at season-end step 7.
retirement.modifierOrder: multiply (usage, contract, trait mults), then add (scars, heavy wear), then clamp
retirement._finalSeasonNote: At preseason week P1, a fighter whose chance (computed with usage 1.0) is >= 60% announces a final season: status final_season, retirement certain at season end.
retirement._leavingNote: A free agent unsigned at two consecutive season ends leaves the league (removed like a retirement but not counted as one for intake).

injury._doc: Per-round chance p = (base + damagePerMaxHp * min(cap, damageTaken / maxHp) + downedAdd * [downed]) * durabilityMult * race.injury.chanceMult * ageMult * traitMults * statusMults, capped. Rolled after each round from the injury stream; at most one new injury per fighter per match; injuries take effect when the match ends (the fighter plays out the match).
injury.weeksSemantics: weeksOut counts matchweeks (and preseason weeks) the fighter is unavailable, starting with the week after the injury. It decreases by 1 at each week processing; the offseason removes offseasonRecoveryWeeks.

careerEnding._doc: Impossible unless the fighter shows the At risk flag before the match. The lineup screen shows the per-match chance.

injury.pronenessIndex: race.injury.chanceMult * durabilityMult * ageMult * traitMults (1.0 = average human of durability 10 aged under 30)

captaincy._doc: Captain quality CQ (the 'captaincy' integer 1-100 that combat.json captain consumes) = round(sum(weight * component)) + youth penalty + trait and status captaincy adds, clamp 1..100. Components are 0-100: leadership = effective ldr (1-20) * 5; composure = effective cmp * 5; experience = min(100, careerRounds * 100 / experienceCareerRoundsFor100); seniority = min(100, matchweeksAtClub * 100 / seniorityMatchweeksFor100); standing = clamp(pivot + perRatingPointVsTopFiveAvg * (rating - mean rating of the club's five best fit fighters), 0, 100). CQ is recomputed at every lineup lock and at season end.

inFightProposal._doc: ADOPTED by combat (combat.json captain, docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md sys-fight-captain); applied by the SIM. Grades supply auraComposure and rallyComposure (in-fight composure points). Lifecycle supplies each fighter's CQ, the lineup captain and the vice-captain in the fight setup. Reliability, not damage (research D2/C8).
inFightProposal.aura: while the acting captain stands: every fielded ally (captain included) gets grade.auraComposure composure

rally.trigger: first time per round an ally other than the acting captain is downed while the acting captain stands

captainDown.handover: when Shaken ends: the vice-captain if fielded and standing, else the standing ally with the highest CQ (ties: lower slot); acting CQ = CQ - actingCaptainCqPenalty, grade recomputed

inFightProposal.effectCap: captain-sourced modifiers may not change any combat quantity by more than 10%

captaincy.lineupCaptain: the club captain if fielded; else the vice-captain if fielded; else the highest-CQ fielded fighter (ties: seniority, rating, fighter id). That fighter is the lineup's captain for the match; combat receives their CQ, minus actingCaptainCqPenalty unless they are the club captain. If the lineup captain is downed, combat's handover passes the role to the vice-captain if fielded and up, else the highest-CQ fielded ally who is up, also at CQ - actingCaptainCqPenalty.

viceCaptain.aiPolicy: second-highest CQ among the five projected starters

mentoring.source: club captain's grade.mentorDevMult, pro-rated by the share of the season's matchweeks they held the role at this club

strip.evaluatedAt: lineup lock (so changing the club captain back and forth between matches is free)
strip.appliesWhen: the club captain at this lock differs from the one at the previous lock, and the previous captain is still at the club, fit, held the role >= 4 matchweeks, and no exemption applies
exemptIf: previous captain injured with >= 4 weeks remaining
previous captain is made vice-captain at the same lock

passedOver.evaluatedAt: lineup lock after a captain change
passedOver.appliesTo: each fit club-mate with humanAge >= 30 and CQ >= new club captain CQ + 15 who is not the vice-captain

captainDeparted.appliesWhen: a club captain who held the role >= 19 matchweeks leaves the club, or suffers a career-ending injury, before season end

captaincy.aiPolicy: AI clubs name as club captain the highest CQ among their five projected starters at preseason week P1 and whenever the role falls vacant; ties: seniority, rating, fighter id. D-I (agreed lifecycle/economy timing): the choice is made in the season-end AI phase for the new season, and an incumbent is replaced there only if a challenger exceeds him by economy.json ai.captainHysteresis (5) CQ; mid-season the AI changes captain only on vacancy or when the captain is injured with >= 4 weeks remaining (an exempt change), so it never triggers Snubbed. Vacancy for the player: the game names an interim captain (same rule) and flags it in the digest.

chemistry._doc: DELEGATED (D-D): in M1, chemistry is limited to these lineup modifiers; no broader morale system. Structural and visible (P-17). Lineup chemistry for the five fielded fighters = sum of trait chemistry terms (captain's own terms x captainTraitChemistryMult) + club captain grade.chemistry + status terms, computed at lineup lock and clamped to [min, max]. Every fielded fighter without chemistryImmune gets cmp + chemistry / 2 (rounded toward zero) in the fight-setup stats; this is a MANAGEMENT-side modifier (the sim only sees the resulting stat). Set composureDivisor to 0 to disable chemistry without touching other data.

statuses.label: Final season
statuses.text: Announced this is their last season: retires at season end. +1 composure.

statuses.label: Still tender
statuses.duration: the next 2 matches the fighter starts
statuses.text: Back from a moderate or serious injury. Injury chance x1.25 for 2 matches.

statuses.label: At risk
statuses.text: A serious injury could end this fighter's career. The lineup screen shows the chance.

statuses.label: Snubbed
statuses.text: Stripped of the captaincy. -2 lineup chemistry while fielded.

statuses.label: Passed over
statuses.text: A senior fighter who expected the armband. -1 lineup chemistry while fielded.

statuses.label: Losing the room
statuses.duration: while the club captain has not been fielded in 4+ consecutive matches while fit; ends when fielded
statuses.text: A captain who keeps sitting out. -10 captain quality until fielded again.

statuses.label: Captain departed
statuses.text: The dressing room lost its captain mid-season. -1 lineup chemistry.

worldGen._doc: Sample a band, then a whole humanAge in it, then age = round(humanAge * lifespan / 80), clamped to [race.debutAge.min, age at humanAge 40].

intake._doc: TUNABLE; coordinate with the league/economy designer (trials day, P-18). rookies = clamp(round(clubs * basePerClub) + retirementsThisSeason, round(clubs * minPerClub), round(clubs * maxPerClub)). retirementsThisSeason counts retirements and career-ending injuries, not unsigned fighters who left the league (that would feed back into itself). Race by race.intakeWeight; age uniform in race.debutAge.

veteranHistory._doc: Fighters generated older than their debut get an estimated history so captaincy, veteran traits and wear are consistent: proSeasons = age - sampled debut age; careerRounds = round(proSeasons * roundsPerSeasonPlayed * U); wear = the decline table summed over the human-years already lived past 31; each pro season rolls scarChancePerSeasonPlayed for a scar; acquired-trait thresholds are then checked once.

hiredBlade._doc: Hook for open-006 (league/economy owns the rule). Generated like a free agent with qualityShiftExamples.hiredBlade, humanAge band 24-33, normal trait roll, on one-match terms; earns XP like anyone else.

soakTargets._doc: Pass bands for the 20-season headless soak test (spec section 8). Measured from season 3 so world-generation warm-up is excluded.
soakTargets._ageBandNote: Widened for D-T (veterans play on): see core/fighters README.
